# LibPARI.jl

> LibPARI.jl is a Julia wrapper for the PARI/GP number-theory library. It exposes a `Gen` value type wrapping every PARI object, idiomatic arithmetic and conversions, nearly 1200 bindings generated from PARI's `pari.desc` under `LibPARI.PARI`, and `gp_eval` for any GP-language expression.
